name: Notice
description: Mortar foundation notice, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.tone: neutral | info | success | warning | danger (rendered as data-tone, omitted for neutral)
props.announce: boolean (status, or alert for danger; announced when it appears)
props.onDismiss: () => void (focus moves to the next control)

contract.usage: Import { Notice } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
